claims.claim: Defence Construction Canada issued an Advance Procurement Notice for a data centre in the National Capital Region, reference WA257004_88262.
The planned facility is 60 MW and estimated at $1.5 billion to $1.85 billion.
The project is conditional on approval to proceed and DCC gives no guarantee the contract will proceed.
Solicitation is anticipated in Winter 2027, with a listed delivery date of 2027/02/01.
The contract carries security requirements and requires facility security clearance.
At 60 MW the facility meets Ottawa's definition of a hyperscale data centre (at least 50 MW).
Hydro Ottawa received 34 large-load requests in two years, about 60 per cent (653 MW) data centre-related.
claims.attributed_to: Bryce Conrad, Hydro Ottawa CEO, via Ottawa Sun

claims.claim: The project has not been officially approved by government and details are scarce.
No specific site, awarded contract, construction start or operating department is published.
DND referred questions to the Communications Security Establishment, which did not respond by deadline.
A DND Data Centre roof replacement at 101 Goldenrod Driveway, Ottawa, is a separate contract.
FedDev's $500 million Regional AI Initiative expansion and the 2024 ISED AI compute consultation do not mention the Ottawa data centre.

An aggregator snapshot of the same solicitation, last checked Oct. 14, shows Approximate Estimate: 1.5B to 1.85B with no amendment posted.
